name: Boubyan Bank K.S.C
summary: Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P., together with its affiliated entities, delivers a comprehensive array of banking and financial solutions across a broad international footprint, serving clients in Kuwait, the wider Middle East and North Africa regions, Europe, the United Kingdom, and other global markets. The institution structures its operations into four key divisions: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking and International Operations, and Treasury. Its product portfolio encompasses a wide range of deposit options, including accounts for salaries, youth, savings, current transactions, and call deposits, alongside various fixed-term investments. Clients can access diverse financing solutions for needs such as home ownership and construction, vehicle purchases, furnishings, healthcare, and education, in addition to short-term loans and credit facilities secured by existing deposits. Trade finance mechanisms like letters of credit and guarantees are also available. Furthermore, the bank issues various payment cards, including credit, debit, and prepaid options. Boubyan Bank caters to individuals and institutions with consumer finance products, credit cards, and a full spectrum of deposit and general branch services. For its corporate and business clientele, it delivers Sharia-compliant products like Murabaha and Ijarah, specialized trade services, and other bespoke financial solutions, complemented by robust treasury services. The bank further extends its portfolio with an array of insurance coverages, encompassing motor, home, fire, general accident, car, marine and aviation risks, family takaful, and medical policies. Its investment activities are broad, covering direct investments, equity stakes in associate companies, and both domestic and global real estate ventures, along with comprehensive asset and wealth management services. The institution also engages in Islamic financing, notably Murabaha transactions with other financial institutions both locally and internationally, and actively manages its own funding requirements. Moreover, the bank extends brokerage services to institutional investors and affluent individuals. It embraces modern banking through mobile, online, and WhatsApp platforms, and also provides property management expertise. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait, Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P. operates under the ownership of National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. as its subsidiary.

name: Boursa Kuwait Securities Company K.P.S.C.
summary: Boursa Kuwait Securities Company K.P.S.C., along with its various subsidiaries, operates and manages the stock market in Kuwait. Its comprehensive suite of services includes facilitating real estate investment trusts (REITs), overseeing rights issues, enabling short selling, arranging stock swaps, processing tender offers, and executing off-exchange transactions. Beyond trading activities, the company provides consulting expertise in administrative, economic, and information technology domains. Core operational functions involve offering clearing, settlement, and custodial services, alongside acting as a trustee. It is also responsible for central depository functions, maintaining share registers, and handling the transfer of ownership. The company was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Gulf Bank K.S.C.
summary: Gulf Bank K.S.C.P. provides various banking products and services to individual, corporate, and institutional customers in Kuwait. It operates through Commercial Banking, and Treasury & Investments segments. The company accepts current accounts, salary accounts, savings accounts, youth programs, Al Danah accounts, and term and time deposits. Its loan products include housing, consumer, secured cash, auto, secured, revolving term, and installment loans. The company also offers project finance, letters of credit, and letters of guarantee, as well as overdrafts, and working capital and long-term asset financing solutions. In addition, it provides digital wallets; credit, prepaid, and debit cards; investment funds, online trading, and transaction and merchant banking services; and foreign exchange, custodian/investment controller, portfolio management, GB products sales back office, bond’s fiscal/paying agent, back office, public and private placements, and funds and structured products. Further, the company offers money market and treasury services; and safety deposit box, credit card facilities, ministries' salary, salary transfer, advisory, online banking, travel insurance, and other services. Gulf Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P.
summary: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P., along with its various subsidiaries, is a prominent enterprise based in Kuwait that focuses on establishing and managing universities and colleges, both within Kuwait and internationally. The company segments its operations primarily into Higher Education and "Other Ventures." Beyond its core academic endeavors, Humansoft delivers a diverse range of services. These include computer programming, advertising, publication, and distribution, as well as engaging in the buying and selling of shares and bonds. It also offers various technology, e-commerce, and media-related solutions. In the realm of education, Humansoft provides diploma degrees in fields such as business administration, information technology, and engineering. It develops specialized content-based educational programs and offers extensive learning solutions, including e-learning content for IT, business, desktop applications, and languages, alongside professional certification courses and learning management systems. Furthermore, the company offers expert consulting services for the deployment, hosting, and management of e-learning platforms. The company also plays a role in nurturing nascent educational institutions. It conducts courses focusing on technical, application, and business skills, and implements a cyclical pedagogical syllabus learning system. Additionally, Humansoft assists with career development and job placements, and provides management and training services specifically designed for schools. Founded in 1994, Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Kuwait Finance House K.S.C.P.
summary: Kuwait Finance House K.S.C.P. (KFH), founded in Kuwait City in 1977, is a leading provider of Sharia-compliant financial services, extending its operations across the Middle East, North America, Europe, and Asia. The institution organizes its wide array of offerings into four key divisions: Treasury, Retail and Private Banking, Corporate Banking, and Investment. The Treasury segment manages liquidity, engages in murabaha investments, deals in Sukuk, and handles deposits with other financial institutions and international banking connections. The Retail and Private Banking division caters to individuals with various products and services, including tailored solutions for high-net-worth clients. Corporate Banking delivers specialized services and investment products to businesses, such as commodity and real estate murabaha financing, local leasing, wakala, and istisna'a facilities. Meanwhile, the Investment segment focuses on overseeing direct equity and real estate holdings. KFH's comprehensive banking portfolio features diverse account types (including current, saving, and investment accounts), debit and credit cards, and multiple financing options like installment, consumer, and vehicle loans. Additional financial services include foreign exchange transactions and letters of guarantee. Beyond its core banking activities, KFH is also involved in real estate development, leasing, trading, and management; IT services suchas maintenance, consultancy, and software; healthcare; equity investments; and a suite of financial advisory, underwriting, and custody services. Furthermore, it offers auto leasing, insurance, and used car trading, import, and export services. These products and services are made accessible through an extensive network comprising approximately 526 branches and 1,733 automated teller machines.

name: Mabanee Company K.P.S.C.
summary: Mabanee Company K.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, provides construction and real estate investment services in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia. It operates through Construction and Real Estate Operations; and Hotel Operations segments. The Construction and Real Estate Operations segment consists of leasing properties, real estate development, projects leasing, and construction activities. Its Hotel Operations segment provides hotel services through Hilton Garden Inn Hotel and Waldorf Astoria Hotel, Kuwait. The company is also involved in general trading and contracting; warehousing facilities; management; purchase, sale, and rental of land and properties; management of owned and leased properties; trading of equipment and construction materials; operation and management of family entertainment centers; advertising, publishing, distribution, and art production; real estate brokerage; freight forwarding; construction and operation of hospitals, medical centres, and governmental and private dispensaries; repair and maintenance of refrigerators and air purifiers; production and distribution of chilled water; and accommodation and food services. In addition, it develops mixed-use destinations; operates and manages shopping malls; and designs and manages projects. Mabanee Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Marakez Real Estate Development Company K.P.S.C
summary: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C. (MARAKEZ.KW) is a prominent real estate firm active in both Kuwait and the Syrian Arab Republic. Its core operations encompass the acquisition, ownership, and divestiture of various real estate assets and land plots. Furthermore, it provides comprehensive management, leasing, and marketing services for properties belonging to external clients. MARAKEZ also holds and operates a diverse portfolio of specialized properties, including resorts, hotels, health and sports facilities, private hospitals, and various tourist accommodations. This extends to commercial centers and residential communities. Beyond its direct property investments, the company delivers real estate consultation and research services. It also engages in property development and construction for both private and public sector projects, offers maintenance solutions for buildings and properties, and organizes industry events such as real estate exhibitions and auctions. Additionally, the firm has a financial arm involved in buying and selling securities and debentures. Established in 1999, the company maintains its headquarters in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
summary: Established in 1998 and headquartered in Kuwait City, Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) operates as a leading real estate development group, leveraging its subsidiaries. The company's core activities involve the construction of diverse properties, ranging from residential options like villa communities and apartments, to various commercial ventures such as office buildings, business centers, healthcare facilities, and retail and dining establishments. Beyond development, Al-Mazaya provides a comprehensive suite of services, including project oversight, marketing strategies, property administration, and portfolio management. It also offers expertise in real estate valuation, research, and brokerage. Furthermore, the company is actively involved in acquiring, owning, and selling land, and it manages, invests in, leases, and rents a broad spectrum of assets including hotels, health clubs, recreational parks, exhibition venues, restaurants, and both residential and commercial complexes and resorts. Al-Mazaya maintains a significant operational presence across Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Turkey, and Bahrain.

name: National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P.
summary: National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial and investment services and solutions to individual, corporate, and institutional clients in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, NBK Wealth, Islamic Banking, Group Center, and International Banking. The company offers consumer loans, credit cards, trade finance, deposits, foreign exchange and advisory, and other related services. It also provides a full range of asset management, custody, brokerage, lending, and other customized and banking services to high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients. In addition, the company offers Islamic banking products and services; investment products; and treasury services and products. National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: National Industries Group Holding - KPSC
summary: National Industries Group Holding - KPSC operates as a diverse conglomerate across Kuwait and international markets. Its principal activities include investments and financial services, real estate and construction, specialized engineering and chemical production, and information technology solutions. Within the industrial and construction sectors, the company supplies a wide array of products, such as various stones and decorative finishes, concrete and HDPE pipes, ready-mix concrete, plastic goods, white blocks, ceramics, interlocks, cladding materials, mortar, paints, and lime powder. It also manufactures petrochemical products. The financial services division provides expert advisory for mergers and acquisitions, corporate defense strategies, restructurings, and manages client portfolios alongside risk architecture. In real estate, the group is engaged in the acquisition, development, and sale of properties and land. Additionally, it oversees the management and operation of numerous hospitality and leisure assets, including hotels, clubs, residential properties, resorts, sporting stores, restaurants, galleries, parks, and gardens. The company was established in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.

name: Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.
summary: Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. (ZAIN), through its various affiliated entities, delivers a comprehensive suite of wireless communication offerings. Its core business involves the full lifecycle management of mobile telephone systems, from procurement and deployment to ongoing operation and maintenance. Beyond traditional mobile services, the company provides advanced solutions including smart package bundles, flexible mobility options, Voice over IP (VoIP), and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. It also specializes in hosted managed services, managed cybersecurity, and cloud connectivity. The firm diversifies its activities by investing in various securities. Geographically, ZAIN maintains operations across a significant MENA and African footprint, specifically in Kuwait, Jordan, Sudan, Iraq, Bahrain, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, and South Sudan. Founded in 1983, its principal headquarters are located in Kuwait City, Kuwait. Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG.
